intro: Irregularities and unverified items for manual review. None of these blocks the merge or the site. Each item cites its source, or states that no source was found.

items.title: Repo had no site files
items.detail: At the start of this session the repo contained only README.md ('# Poker2'). There was no index page, no data, and no COORDINATION.md. GitHub Pages was already set to build from branch main, path '/'. Main later gained other sessions' dashboards. This session's site is kept separate under verified/ (live at /Poker2/verified/) so that no other session's files are overwritten.

items.title: Branch name does not follow the task spec
items.detail: The task spec asks for session branches named session-<id>/<task>. This session works on arena/a22d577b-poker2, which is the branch assigned by the session. The name was not changed, and this deviation is recorded in COORDINATION.md.
items.source_label: Repo README (only file on main at session start)

items.title: Official poster does not state re-entry rules
items.detail: The official daily poster lists the Mon–Thu $200 NLH $10K GTD and the Sat–Sun $200 NLH $25K GTD without mentioning re-entry. The official structure sheets allow re-entry (Mon–Thu until level 9, Sat–Sun until level 11) and, on the nightly event, re-entry until level 9. The daily terms also call these events 'Single Day' while allowing re-entry. All Wynn daily events are therefore in the excluded section.

items.title: Wynn daily PDFs carry a 2025 version stamp
items.detail: The daily poster and structure PDF URLs contain Cloudinary version numbers that decode to July 2025. The events are dated 2026. Confirm the current versions on wynnlasvegas.com before relying on them.

items.title: WPT PDFs carry 2025 version stamps
items.detail: The WPT schedule and structures PDF URLs contain Cloudinary version numbers that decode to 2025. The events are dated 2026. Confirm the current versions on wynnlasvegas.com.

items.title: WPT structure sheets not fully reviewed
items.detail: Only the first chunk of the WPT structures PDF has been read (general terms: registration opens four hours before start, cash or Wynn chips only, Wynn Rewards membership required, W-2G for winnings over $5,000). The remaining sections were not read, so all WPT events are UNVERIFIED or excluded by event name.

items.title: Schedule lists some events as 'Day 2' or 'Day 1A' flights
items.detail: Several WPT rows are named for flights or later days (for example 'Day 2' and 'Day 1A'). Under the rule in the Venetian sheets, a flight-based event may let a player buy a later flight. These are excluded until the structure sheet is read.

items.title: Guarantee includes ClubWPT Gold money
items.detail: The WPT World Championship guarantee includes added money that the official schedule attributes to ClubWPT Gold. The schedule does not say that this money is available to Nevada players, so guarantees on those rows are shown as published and are not treated as Nevada prize pools.

items.title: Multi-flight events allow a later flight after a loss
items.detail: Venetian structure sheets for events 01, 07, 19, 47 and 56 say that a player who bags chips for Day 2 may not play a subsequent flight. A player who has not bagged may play a later flight, so a second buy-in can buy another starting position. These events are in the excluded section.

items.title: Single-entry status relies on the structure sheet
items.detail: The one-day Venetian structure sheets do not mention re-entry, rebuys or add-ons. Single-entry status in this site means 'no re-entry or add-on stated in the official structure sheet', not 'the poker room confirmed it'. Confirm with the poker room before paying.

items.title: Bounty guarantees include bounty money
items.detail: The structure sheet for Event 36 defines the guarantee as 'prize pool + total bounties'. The same wording appears on the other bounty and PKO sheets reviewed. A bounty guarantee is therefore not a plain prize pool. The ranking uses the official guarantee with this caveat.

items.title: 17 Venetian rows not verified
items.detail: 17 Venetian events have an official schedule row but their structure sheets were not reviewed. Re-entry, flight and add-on status is UNVERIFIED, so they are not in the single-entry list.

items.title: Multi-flight events are named by flight
items.detail: Event 26 ($800, flights 1A–1F, $500K) is in the excluded section because of its flight naming. Its structure sheet was not reviewed.

items.title: Eligibility: age and loyalty card
items.detail: The Venetian structure sheets (rule 2) say players must be 21 or over and have a Venetian Rewards card. Wynn's general terms say players must be Wynn Rewards members. The user must sign up before playing.

items.title: Third-party resort fee figures conflict with official text
items.detail: Third-party sites give different figures: $45 for The Venetian (a 2025 post), $62.36 for The Venetian (an aggregator) and $50 for Wynn (earlier listings). The official Venetian and Wynn terms both say $55 plus tax. The official figure is used. Third-party figures are not used as sources.

items.title: Wynn terms page is a 2026 promotion
items.detail: The Wynn terms page used for the resort fee wording is for an offer valid for stays from Oct 27 to Nov 1, 2026. Those dates have passed. The page is used only for general fee wording. Confirm the current fee on wynnlasvegas.com.

items.title: Wynn tax rate not verified
items.detail: The Wynn terms say 'plus tax' without a rate. The 13.38% Clark County room tax shown in the Venetian terms is used only as a computed figure for Wynn and needs confirmation.

items.title: No nightly rates or walking times verified
items.detail: No official nightly room rate was captured (rates are dynamic). Walking times between the hotels and their poker rooms were not verified. The 'true cost per night', 'walk' and 'quality' fields are therefore blank, as the brief requires.
items.source_label: Venetian official hotel terms (no rate data)

items.title: Strip coverage limited to two properties
items.detail: This pass covers only The Venetian and Wynn Las Vegas. MGM Grand (its poker page returned 'Page not found'), Caesars, Resorts World, Bellagio, Aria, Planet Hollywood and others are NOT covered. The MGM Grand poker page should be found through the official MGM site or flagged for review.
items.source_label: MGM Grand poker page (returned 'Page not found')

items.title: Aggregators used only as leads
items.detail: PokerAtlas, PokerDiscover, MTTDB, Upswing, PokerNews and others were used only to find official pages. Some are stale: the Venetian poker room blog posts are from 2019–2020. No table value comes from an aggregator.
items.source_label: Upswing (lead only, not a source for any value)
